PLAN "Prenatal Strength Maintenance (12 Weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain strength and muscle during second trimester with safe modifications"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation & Technique" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body Strength A":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          trap bar deadlift 4x5..6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          split squat 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg curl machine 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          standing calf raise 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          breathing drills 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body Strength A":
        warmup:
          rower 8m
        main straight_sets:
          seated dumbbell shoulder press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          chest-supported row 4x8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline dumbbell press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat pulldown neutral grip 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable face pull 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          band mobility 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body Strength A":
        warmup:
          elliptical 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front squat to box 4x5..6 rpe 7 rest 150 seconds
          romanian deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          half-kneeling single-arm cable press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          single-arm dumbbell row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          pallof press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
